en: Vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a central market square with landscaped greenery in the foreground and a row of historic townhouses and hotels in the background. Visible signs on the buildings include "Hotel zum Hirsch," "Hotel goldner Löwe," "APOTHEKE," and other shop names. A fountain or monument with a lamppost stands on the square, with a few people and horse-drawn carriages. Printed captions at the bottom read "Stolpen." on the left and "Markt." in red on the right, with the publisher credit "Brück & Sohn Meissen." along the lower margin. Handwritten signatures are present across the bottom.
